questions.asked_as: why did the arm-cell incident happen

arguments.text: Why did the arm-cell incident INC-C3-0011 on ARM-3A in CELL-3 happen?

Q1.C3.reason: Only "ARM-3A has firmware 5.6.0" cites it: that claim comes from the CMMS work orders' Firmware After cells and cites every ARM-3A work-order row, WO-26-0911's included, but states none of their work.

Q1.C4.reason: Only "ARM-3A has firmware 5.6.0" cites it: that claim comes from the CMMS work orders' Firmware After cells and cites every ARM-3A work-order row, WO-26-0911's included, but states none of their work. No statement names CAL-ARM3A-0911, CAL-ARM3A-0818 or their errors.

Q1.C6.reason: Only ServiceNow's "ARM-3A has configuration TCP z=145.5 mm" (CHG0030013, the 2026-08-18 change) cites it; no statement says the 2026-09-10 work has no change record or requalification.

Q1.C7.reason: Only the incident description cites the report's page; it states what happened, not the cause (the fingers closing about 4 mm lower than taught is not in it).

Q1.C2.reason: The compiler now emits the bags' /diagnostics rows as status_report records (25, of which 23 name CAL-ARM3A-0911), but Memory does not consolidate status_report yet (its event index reads incident, intervention and declared event tables), so no claim cites them. cell_config.yaml's residual action is a configuration value Memory does not consolidate either.

Q1.C5.reason: SOP-CELL-021's revisions are PDF text (document_block records): no Deploy template maps an SOP (Deploy reports document_unmatched), and Memory consolidates no claim from document text, so no claim cites them.

Q1.C1.reason: The incident report's description states that the fingers struck fixture PF-3 at pick P1, collision detection stopped the arm and the operator pressed the E-stop at OP-2. The 41.7 Nm against 35.0 Nm reading is not in this answer (Q7's syslog statement carries it).

questions.asked_as: what changed since the last good run

Q2.C2.reason: Only "ARM-3A has firmware 5.6.0" cites it: that claim comes from the CMMS work orders' Firmware After cells and cites every ARM-3A work-order row, WO-26-0911's included, but states none of their work. The bracket refit is not stated by any statement citing WO-26-0911 (the downtime log's "bracket refit" line is a different source).

Q2.C3.reason: Each run's configuration is stated as a Ledger configuration thread bound by the run sheet's pin, and the two runs' threads differ, but the threads are opaque ids: no statement names CAL-ARM3A-0818 or CAL-ARM3A-0911 or their errors.

Q2.C8.reason: The vendor-copy run's has_member claim rests on the 2026-09-09 bag's record, but no statement says the two paths hold one file.

Q2.C4.reason: SOP-CELL-021's revisions are PDF text (document_block records): no Deploy template maps an SOP (Deploy reports document_unmatched), and Memory consolidates no claim from document text, so no claim cites them.

Q2.C5.reason: The compiler now emits the bags' /diagnostics rows as status_report records (25, of which 23 name CAL-ARM3A-0911), but Memory does not consolidate status_report yet (its event index reads incident, intervention and declared event tables), so no claim cites them.

Q2.C6.reason: Memory holds the cell PC's estimated clock fits as inferred maps_to and clock_map claims, but they are about clock nodes, which no claim links to a run or a machine, so no query from a declared id reaches them; and they rest on the compiler's clock_mapping estimates only as records they were built from, never as their subject or object, so no claim of the graph cites clock.0909 or clock.0914.

Q2.C7.reason: ARM-3A's firmware 5.6.0 is stated from March 2026, open-ended, so it held through both runs: the controller software did not change. The application version (PALLET_C3 1.4.0) is not stated.

Q3.C1.reason: Only "ARM-3A has firmware 5.6.0" cites it: that claim comes from the CMMS work orders' Firmware After cells and cites every ARM-3A work-order row, WO-26-0911's included, but states none of their work. The finger set and TCP z of the incident run are not stated.

Q3.C2.reason: The incident run's configuration is stated as Ledger configuration threads bound by the run sheet's pins of CAL-ARM3A-0911 and the vision export, but the threads are opaque ids: no statement names the calibration or its 1.86 px.

Q3.C3.reason: The software, collision limit and residual action are configuration values of cell_config.yaml, which Memory does not consolidate (the stale export is never pinned to a run, ADR 0009 §4); the bag's start and collision rows are status_report records Memory does not read yet. No claim cites them.

Q3.C4.reason: cell_config.yaml's values are configuration_value records Memory does not consolidate, and the stale export is deliberately pinned to no run (Platform ADR 0009 §4): no claim cites them.

Q3.C5.reason: The asset register is a table no Deploy preset maps: its GRP-3A row stays an untyped structured_record, and no claim cites it.

Q3.C6.reason: LEG-01 is stated to have firmware 3.2.0 from 2026-09-13 (WO-26-0913), and the patrol run's configuration is bound by the run sheet's pin. The asset register's stale 3.1.4 is not stated.

Q4.C1.reason: Only "LEG-01 has firmware 3.2.0" cites WO-26-0916's row (the incomplete recording, the replaced SSD). The patrol run's integrity findings (error, warning) are in the answer, but they rest on the truncated bag's findings only through the records they were built from, which are not citations (ADR 0011 §4).

Q4.C2.reason: Only the incident description cites the report's page; it does not say that no wrist camera images exist.

Q4.C3.reason: Only the incident description cites the report's clock note ("about a minute and a half later"); no statement says the offset is inferred, its 96.7 s estimate or the survey's +94.1 s.

Q4.C5.reason: Only "ARM-3A has firmware 5.6.0" cites it: that claim comes from the CMMS work orders' Firmware After cells and cites every ARM-3A work-order row, WO-26-0911's included, but states none of their work. No statement says the camera's pose was never measured.

Q4.C6.reason: Only "LEG-01 has firmware 3.2.0" cites WO-26-0916's row; the SSD replacement and the cache-flush change are not stated.

Q4.C4.reason: SOP-CELL-021's revisions are PDF text (document_block records): no Deploy template maps an SOP (Deploy reports document_unmatched), and Memory consolidates no claim from document text, so no claim cites them.

Q5.C1.reason: Statements about the incident (its assets, site, kind and description) cite the report's timeline page, but the HMI's 14:32:38 and 14:32:41 entries are not in this answer: the report's timeline entries hang off the incident node and the query does not reach them.

Q5.C3.reason: The site survey's warning is PDF text (document_block records) that no Deploy template maps, and Memory consolidates no claim from document text: no claim cites it.

Q5.C2.reason: The incident description states that the cell PC's event log shows the same alarms about a minute and a half later than the HMI. The 96.7 s estimate and the missing time sync are not stated.

questions.asked_as: do the CMMS and syslog times of the stop agree

Q7.C4.reason: The answer carries both stops' times and the same-stop claim, but on two clocks Memory relates by no mapping: no statement compares them or says the CMMS time is 32 s late.

Q7.C1.reason: The syslog statements carry the PSTOP (collision on joint 5, 41.7 Nm > 35.0 Nm) and the ESTOP at OP-2, each at its tick on the syslog's declared America/New_York clock (14:32:38 and 14:32:41).

Q7.C2.reason: The CMMS downtime record DT-26-0914-01 is stated as a protective stop of ARM-3A at its tick on the downtime log's declared clock (14:33:10).

Q7.C3.reason: A stated same_as claim joins CMMS stop DT-26-0914-01 and syslog 4182, from A. Novak's assertion.

Q8.C1.reason: Deploy maps ENV-P2-01 as an authorisation_envelope whose approved configuration is not covered (the envelope register names none), and Memory states an envelope only as a configuration approved at a site, so no claim cites it.
